subject: Cost and Management Accounting
question_text:
14.  
The following figures are extracted from the books of a company:  
 
Budgeted overheads ` 20,000 (Fixed ` 12,000, Variable ` 8,000)  
 
Budgeted output 2,500 units 
 
Actual Overheads ` 21,800 (Fixed ` 11,800, Variable ` 10,000)  
 
Actual output 3000  
 
Variable Overheads and fixed overheads cost variance will be:  
(a)  400 (A) and 2600 (F)  
(b)  400 (A) and 200 (F)  
(c)  2000 (A) and 200 (F)  
(d)  2000 (F) and 200 (A) 
(2 Marks)
suggested_answer: (A) 400 (A) and 2,600 (F) Variable overhead cost variance: Standard Variable overheads - Actual variable overheads 8,000/2,500 x 3,000 – 10,000 = 400A Fixed overhead cost variance: Standard fixed overheads - Actual fixed overheads 12,000/2,500 x 3,000 – 11,800 = 2,600F
